summary: Reviewed cloudflare-worker-d1.js, validated syntax and static UI/player/API dispatch, and ran public endpoint smoke tests. The source contains embedded dashboard and JWPlayer HTML, but the configured public host serves a generic React shell at / and /dashboard rather than the Worker UI.

critical.issue: Configured REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host returns the generic React index HTML without ShinDora dashboard markup, so the deployed/public route does not expose the embedded Worker UI.

integration_issues.issue: Public host appears routed to the existing React app instead of the cloudflare-worker-d1.js deployment; Worker /v/:slug HTML could not be runtime-verified on that host.

action_items: Deploy or route the configured public hostname to the Worker defined by wrangler.toml, then re-run /, /dashboard, and /v/:slug runtime checks.
Verify a seeded slug on the deployed Worker so JWPlayer HTML and source serialization are confirmed end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Static Worker implementation has the requested renderDashboardAppHtml, renderPlayerHtml, JWPlayer library, and API dispatch branches; deployment routing is the current blocker.
seed_data_creation: None; no D1 writes or seed data were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static syntax/source checks passed and missing-target validation for /api/stream and /api/download passed. Public runtime host is not the Worker artifact, so /v/:slug and real proxying remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The test URL from frontend/.env resolves to a React application shell. Its root response lacks the Worker-specific ShinDora markup even though cloudflare-worker-d1.js contains it, indicating deployment/ingress hostname mismatch or the Worker was not deployed to the tested hostname.
